name: nose-review
description: Review code generated during a Codex turn for duplication with Nose

interface.shortDescription: Review changed code for duplication before Codex finishes.
interface.longDescription: Snapshots the repository at prompt start, runs one local Nose scan when the turn stops if code changed, and asks Codex to inspect up to three relevant duplicate families.
defaultPrompt: Review my current code changes for duplication.
